description: Pydantic-generated schemas from the llm-grounding repository. Endpoint contracts are included below because several routes currently serialize raw dictionaries instead of declaring FastAPI response models.
title: llm-grounding /eval/v1 protocol schema registry

/eval/v1/capabilities.response_contract: Static dictionary returned by the capabilities handler; see x_raw_responses.capabilities. FastAPI currently exposes this as an unconstrained object because no response_model is declared.

/eval/v1/config-schema.response_contract: Dictionary containing protocol_version, supported_pipeline, and JSON Schemas for EvalConfigOverrides and EffectiveConfiguration.

GET.response_contract: Envelope with corpus_id and a chunks array of arbitrary JSON objects.

POST.response_contract: Raw operation dictionary described in x_raw_responses.operation.

GET.response_contract: Envelope with corpus_id and a documents array of arbitrary JSON objects.

POST.response_contract: Raw operation dictionary described in x_raw_responses.operation.

/eval/v1/corpora/{corpus_id}/evidence.response_contract: Envelope with corpus_id and an evidence array derived from chunk evidence/source_spans.

/eval/v1/embeddings.response_contract: Envelope with records serialized from EmbeddingRecord; this route is conditionally mounted when an embedding fetcher is available.

/eval/v1/observations/{rag_run_id}.response_contract: Persisted RagRunObservation serialized with mode='json' and exclude_none=True.

/eval/v1/operations/{operation_id}.response_contract: Raw operation dictionary described in x_raw_responses.operation.

/eval/v1/query.response_contract: RagRunObservation.model_dump(mode='json', exclude_none=True); the route currently declares response_model=None.

/eval/v1/requests/{request_id}.response_contract: Persisted RagRunObservation serialized with mode='json' and exclude_none=True.

/eval/v1/retrieve.response_contract: RagRunObservation.model_dump(mode='json', exclude_none=True); the route currently declares response_model=None.
